disciplinary_grounds.description: Judicial determination of mental incompetence or incapacity preventing safe practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misrepresentation or unlawful/unprofessional conduct under physician-educator license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The division in collaboration with the board may withdraw a license under this section at any time for material misrepresentation or unlawful or unprofessional conduct.

definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means: to diagnose, treat, correct, administer anesthesia, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, including to perform cosmetic medical procedures, or to attempt to do so, by any means or instrumentality

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign graduates must submit current ECFMG certification or complete the 'fifth pathway program' which includes passing a qualifying examination (ECFMG exam or USMLE Parts I and II), one calendar year of supervised clinical training in a US accredited setting, and completion of required postgraduate training

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A temporary license may be issued for telemedicine services to out-of-state licensees who have applied for endorsement; the telemedicine service must be within the scope of the nonresident health care license and the patient must be located in Utah
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An individual with a temporary license issued under this section is authorized to provide a telemedicine service if: the telemedicine service is a service the individual is licensed to perform under the nonresident health care license of the state, district, or territory that issued the nonresident health care license; at the time the telemedicine service is performed, the patient is located in Utah
telehealth_prescribing_rules.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A physician or surgeon may not enter into a collaborative practice arrangement with more than three full-time equivalent associate physicians.
